fullPassage: If you do have an opinion, do not be afraid to voice it, both in tutorials and written work. Undergraduate tutorials all over the country each week are full of students, many of whom have great ideas, but who feel hesitant about speaking out or including them in essays. Working at degree level is all about reading, understanding and forming educated opinions based upon what you have read, but it is also, at its best, about having your own viewpoint. You will not get it right all the time, of course. There will be occasions when your tutor will point you in another direction, but if you offer an opinion, you will be impressing the lecturers, stimulating debate and, as importantly, saving yourself a lot of time. By venturing an opinion in a tutorial, you will get instant feedback, relevant guidance as to where to go next and a highly gratified tutor who will remember your original contribution to the course — always a good thing.

✅ ② stimulating: 현재분사 능동 — 원문 일치
❌ ③ which will remember → who will remember (선행사 tutor는 사람. 관계대명사 who 필수)
✅ ④ saving yourself: 재귀대명사 + 동명사 — 원문 일치
det.tip: 선행사 사람(tutor) → 관계대명사 who. which는 사물용이라 비문.

questions.passage: If you do have an opinion, do not be afraid to voice it, both in tutorials and written work. Undergraduate tutorials all over the country each week are full of students, many of whom have great ideas, but who feel hesitant about speaking out or including them in essays. Working at degree level is all about reading, understanding and forming educated opinions based upon what you have read, but it is also, at its best, about having your own viewpoint. You will not get it right all the time, of course. There will be occasions when your tutor will point you in another direction, but if you offer an opinion, you will be impressing the lecturers, stimulating debate and, as importantly, saving yourself a lot of time. By venturing an opinion in a tutorial, you will get instant feedback, relevant guidance as to where to go next and a highly gratified tutor who will remember your original contribution to the course — always a good thing.

det.korean: 학위 과정에서 중요한 또 다른 요소: 자신만의 관점.

det.tip: S3: your own viewpoint — 학위 학습의 또 다른 핵심 = 자기 관점.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 의견을 두려움 없이 말하면 즉각 피드백·관련 안내·교수의 만족과 기억이라는 보상을 얻는다는 메시지 — 지문 전체 요지.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 읽기만: S3 '자기 관점도 중요' 반대
✅ ② S1+S5+S6: 의견 표현 → 피드백·안내·인정 — 일치
❌ ③ 튜터 우선: 본문은 학생 의견 강조
❌ ④ 시간 낭비: S5 'saving yourself a lot of time' 반대
det.tip: S5·S6: 의견 제시의 실질적 이점 총정리 = 요지.

ch: 자신의 의견을 두려움 없이 제시하면 피드백, 안내, 교수의 인정 등 여러 이점을 얻는다.
튜터의 지시가 학생의 의견보다 항상 우선한다.
의견을 자주 말하는 학생은 시간이 오히려 낭비된다.
